Clyde was a NYC psychedelics dealer — LSD (150–275ug tabs), DMT (crystal and vape carts), mushrooms, and occasional xanax — who delivered directly to Dan's apartment (307 E 76th Street, apartment 17) over roughly ten months spanning 2019 (`+16469534978`, 125 messages, March 2019 – January 2020, saved under the joke "Socialist" contacts label). The relationship is warm and quality-conscious rather than purely transactional: Clyde asks Dan's age and jokes about vetting him as "not a police officer" at their first meeting, apologizes and offers a discount when a batch of mushrooms gave shakes, and promises "free squares" after a leaky cart.

## The relationship

Pricing is explicit and varies by product: LSD tabs at $15 singles / $10 for 5+, a gram of DMT crystal around $170–260 depending on availability, an eighth of mushrooms for $50. Clyde discusses dosing philosophy unprompted — smoking DMT crystal versus vape carts, potency comparisons between batches — suggesting genuine product knowledge rather than a purely arm's-length dealer relationship. He goes quiet for stretches (out of state trips referenced twice) but always resumes with an apology and a restock update. The thread's most vivid moment is a "liked" message from Clyde quoting Dan's own account of a heavy trip: "those doses were from fucking saturn for fucking real. i made my girlfriend watch a bunch of gaspar noe films when she was half dosed and subsequently she no longer believes in the divinity of Jesus Christ or watches the E! channel" — a specific, dated data point on the intensity of Dan's 2020 psychedelic use.
